authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7627 pakṣa explicitly includes Ku. pākho roof and pā̃kh feather, plus Nepali/Bhojpuri nasal feather forms. Nasalization may reflect crossing with puṅkha. The whole pāk/pā̃kh responses fit the containing entry; n-extended pakhnā needs separate morphology. Exact survey form pākʰo is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
